name: Canyon Smokehouse
description: The most popular and atmospheric restaurant at Six Flags Fiesta Texas — Canyon Smokehouse is a spectacular Texas BBQ restaurant serving authentic smoked brisket, ribs and sausage in a magnificent quarry-wall setting. The most satisfying and quintessentially Texan dining experience at any San Antonio theme park.
